items.title: Artie Shaw — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Gil Evans was another guy who knew something about the world.

ctx.x: There are one or two musicians that you hear of who are superb players, but there doesn’t seem to be much else outside the musician.

It’s unfortunate, as I say. See a guy like Bill Evans, I think was a great player, and he seemed to have a view of the world. Bill was a rounded person. Unfortunately the junk [heroin] did him in. Gil Evans was another guy who knew something about the world.
What about . . . just something about Benny Goodman . . . this thing about the way he stared at people?
